run.single_variable: launchdiff vs gen-16 over 233 flag tokens: ONLY --pfsp-scale (2.0->off), --pool-spread (ON->off), --seed (gen-16's own default made explicit). FRESH init.

SECONDARY_vs_gen16.rule: PFSP convicted iff gen-17 > gen-16 with CI clear of 0

CROSS_CHECK_TRIANGLE.STATUS: THE ARENA'S CALIBRATION CERTIFICATE — an instrument result INDEPENDENT of the PFSP finding. Two independent 6,400-game arenas, different opponents, neither fit to the other, agree to 6.3 ELO on a ~30 ELO effect. Cite this whenever a future direct contrast is questioned.

UNATTRIBUTED_RESIDUAL.note: gen-17 sits SLIGHTLY behind gen-15 with the CI excluding zero. This residual is UNATTRIBUTED: seed variance has NEVER been directly measured on this pipeline (no same-config different-seed pair exists), so it cannot be assigned to seed, to the substrate, or to anything else. Do not attribute it without measuring it.

pfsp_conviction.ai_v8_14_ECOLOGY_CONTRAST: ai_v8_14_distill3 ran --pfsp-scale 2.5 + --team-pfsp onesided + --stable-opponent-pfsp and produced +69 ELO — over a DIVERSE, ANCHORED pool (stable opponents + teachers in the opponent set) under a distill KL anchor. Every pathology mechanism had an opposing force. Gen-16 ran PFSP over a homogeneous fresh-lineage self-pool with NONE.
pfsp_conviction.HISTORY_CORRECTION: gen-16 was the first ai_v9-LINEAGE PFSP run, NOT the first ever. eval/pfsp_hardest_win_rate's absence before gen-16 dates the METRIC, not the feature (instrument-vs-subject).

MECHANISM_PAPER_TRAIL_item3.VERDICT: PROMOTION-FEEDBACK PATHWAY REFUTED. Gen-16's turnover did NOT crater — it promoted at EVERY eval cycle, exactly like gen-15, and gen-17 (the healthy arm) promoted FEWER times (10 vs 11, failing the gate once at 18M). Pool composition is identical by construction. SAMPLING-DIVERSITY-COLLAPSE stands as the lead pathway; the promotion pathway is off the list.

pfsp_conviction.return_vehicle: the FLYWHEEL (teachers-in-pool + a uniform-sampling floor), gated. Not a tuning patch.

b1_final_form.CORRECTION: An earlier claim that B1 is PURELY a memory effect owned by the eff fix was TOO STRONG. gen-17 gave back over half of gen-16's in-window gain and is no longer significant vs gen-15.
b1_final_form.FINAL: the eff fix owns the MECHANISM (in-window concentration; the out-of-window stratum is FLAT in all three generations at 0.121/0.152/0.149), and the OPPONENT POPULATION modulates the MAGNITUDE.
b1_final_form.STANDING_RULE: cross-generation B-bars are OPPONENT-CONDITIONAL. Compare via arena games at matched opponents, or state the confound explicitly. Never compare raw across generations silently.

item2_opponent_matched_B1.STATUS: NOT TAKEN — explicitly, not silently skipped.
item2_opponent_matched_B1.why: the arena harness kept only per-pair result JSONs. arena_side.py drives RLPlayer over a websocket and emits NO eval_traces (summary.json + states.npz), which is what the loops detector consumes; Showdown's logs/ holds chat and errors, not battle replays (replay saving is off).
item2_opponent_matched_B1.cost_to_take: ~1-1.5 h: wire trace capture into arena_side.py (a fresh, untested path) + ~200 games.
item2_opponent_matched_B1.why_deferred: building an untested capture path risks another silent-wrong-result of exactly the kind this session already hit three times; the exposure confound is instead carried EXPLICITLY as an open caveat and as the standing rule above.
item2_opponent_matched_B1.what_it_would_prove: B1 and whiff-per-pivot for gen-17 and gen-16 at MATCHED opponents — the confound-free version of the three-generation trend.
